lyrics:
[Intro: slow synth arpeggio, deep kick, long pad]

[Build: bass enters, hi-hats, arpeggio opens]

[Verse 1: yearning male tenor, reverbed]
I'm out past the rope
Where the lights don't go
Water's warm, the night is wide
I won't call, I won't decide

[Chorus: chords lift, voice doubled]
If you want to, swim out to me
I'll be treading water, I'll be easy to see
No hurry, no hurry
If you want to, swim out to me

[Instrumental: arpeggio rising, strings join]

[Verse 2: voice closer, bass moving]
I can hear you on the stair
Feet in, breathing, standing there
I've been where you are before
Scared of what the deep is for

[Chorus: chords lift, voice doubled]
If you want to, swim out to me
I'll be treading water, I'll be easy to see
No hurry, no hurry
If you want to, swim out to me

[Break: kick drops out, pads and voice]
No hurry
No hurry

[Final Build and Release: everything returns, voices layered]
If you want to, swim out to me
I'll be treading water, I'll be easy to see
No hurry, no hurry
If you want to, swim out to me

[Outro: arpeggio alone, slowing, water moving]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, A minor. A long, patient, slowly rising melodic house track.

VOICE: Male tenor, yearning and slightly husky, with long reverb, sung softly and held back. He does not enter until almost a minute in. Doubled in the choruses and layered in the final section.

INSTRUMENTS: A slow, rolling synth arpeggio, a deep four-on-the-floor kick, a warm sustained bass, long pads, closed hi-hats and a soft clap, a string section that joins in the middle, a second higher arpeggio near the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, arpeggio and kick. 0:32 Build, bass in. 0:56 Verse 1. 1:28 Chorus 1. 1:56 Instrumental, strings join. 2:24 Verse 2. 2:54 Chorus 2. 3:22 Break, pads and voice. 3:40 Final build and release. 4:12 Outro, arpeggio slowing, ends 4:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Melodic house for a stadium at night: deep, wide and warm, kick soft and large, voice far back in reverb.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The kick returning under 'If you want to' at 3:40.

STATION FIT: 11 p.m., the late set. The longest track in the pack, for the hour when nobody is talking and the pool lights are the only lights.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Waiting, offering, understanding, open.
